purpose: Verify only backup-authorized SysAdmin/Super Admin may trigger a manual backup.
preconditions: An authenticated principal without and with badms.backup.trigger permission.
action_or_input: Invoke the manual backup service for each principal.
expected_result: Unauthorized trigger is denied; authorized trigger creates a backup operation.

purpose: Verify HoD decisions allow approval or rejection only.
preconditions: A submitted archival request decision is requested.
action_or_input: Evaluate approve and reject actions; reject unsupported action values.
expected_result: Approve and reject map to their distinct outcomes; other values are invalid.

purpose: Verify encryption configuration is restricted to IT Security permission.
preconditions: A sensitive archival request is ready for encryption.
action_or_input: Attempt configuration with and without badms.security.manage.
expected_result: Only authorized IT Security can configure encryption.

purpose: Verify authoritative archival classification requires SysAdmin classification authority.
preconditions: HoD-approved request and principals with/without the permission.
action_or_input: Attempt authoritative classification.
expected_result: Unauthorized actor is denied; invalid classification is rejected.

purpose: Verify sensitive restoration remains pending until SysAdmin review.
preconditions: Sensitive archival item and restoration requester.
action_or_input: Submit restoration and attempt review without required permission.
expected_result: Request remains pending for authorized SysAdmin review; unauthorized review is denied.

purpose: Verify initial classification defaults when submitted classification is invalid or absent.
preconditions: Archival request submitted with unsupported initial classification.
action_or_input: Submit request and inspect persisted classification.
expected_result: System applies the specified initial classification default.

purpose: Verify sensitive data encryption uses AES-256 at rest and in transit.
preconditions: Sensitive request is ready for encryption.
action_or_input: Attempt encryption with a non-AES-256 algorithm.
expected_result: Only AES-256 protection is accepted for both rest and transit.

purpose: Verify classification determines retention treatment without inventing durations.
preconditions: HoD-approved request with authoritative classification.
action_or_input: Classify request and inspect retention metadata.
expected_result: Classification-specific institute retention treatment is recorded; no fixed duration is assumed.

purpose: Verify storage extension requires HoD decision and blocks duplicate pending requests.
preconditions: A quota-full user has zero or one pending request.
action_or_input: Validate pending count; submit and decide a request.
expected_result: One pending request is allowed; a second is blocked; submitted requests require HoD approval/rejection.

purpose: Verify HoD can decide requests only for their own department.
preconditions: HoD belongs to one department; request belongs to another.
action_or_input: Attempt archival decision across departments.
expected_result: Cross-department action is denied.

purpose: Verify HoD can decide storage-extension requests only for their own department.
preconditions: HoD belongs to one department; storage-extension request belongs to another.
action_or_input: Attempt storage-extension decision across departments.
expected_result: Cross-department action is denied.

purpose: Verify a valid local schedule overrides global; global applies without local.
preconditions: Global schedule exists and local schedule may exist for a dataset.
action_or_input: Resolve effective schedule for both cases.
expected_result: Local takes precedence when present; otherwise global applies.

purpose: Verify invalid/conflicting schedule configuration is rejected before application.
preconditions: Authorized schedule manager submits malformed cron and invalid retention.
action_or_input: Save invalid schedule parameters.
expected_result: Configuration is rejected and existing effective schedule remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify scheduled backup succeeds only when its repository is reachable.
preconditions: A scheduled backup is due and repository is reachable/unreachable.
action_or_input: Execute scheduled backup under both repository conditions.
expected_result: Backup proceeds only when reachable; unreachable repository invokes failure handling.

purpose: Verify failed backup alerts SysAdmin within five minutes.
preconditions: A backup becomes Failed and a notification channel is available.
action_or_input: Observe failure alert delivery time.
expected_result: SysAdmin receives alert within five minutes.

purpose: Verify escalation begins at three consecutive failures.
preconditions: Consecutive failure counts below, at, and above three.
action_or_input: Evaluate escalation for counts two, three, and four.
expected_result: No escalation below three; escalation at or above three.

purpose: Verify extension request requires quota reached.
preconditions: Usage is below, equal to, and above allocated quota.
action_or_input: Validate request at each threshold side.
expected_result: Below quota is rejected; equal and above are permitted.

purpose: Verify HoD decision is informed by infrastructure, policy, and user justification.
preconditions: Those decision inputs are available to the reviewer.
action_or_input: Review request using the stated criteria.
expected_result: Decision reflects the supplied criteria; no scoring model is imposed.

purpose: Verify only Super Admin may execute special archival.
preconditions: Offline special archival request and actors with/without authority.
action_or_input: Invoke special archival operation.
expected_result: Only Super Admin is allowed and the operation outcome is recorded.

purpose: Verify global schedule/default policy configuration is limited to Super Admin.
preconditions: Actors with and without global schedule permission.
action_or_input: Configure institution-wide schedule.
expected_result: Only Super Admin authority is allowed.

purpose: Verify protected status and request data is scoped to role, ownership, and department.
preconditions: Multiple requests exist across owners and departments.
action_or_input: Query protected records as a HoD without a known department scope.
expected_result: Access fails closed rather than exposing records beyond the HoD's department.

purpose: Verify only IT Security may manage RBAC and assigned security policies.
preconditions: IT Security and non-security actors attempt administration.
action_or_input: Manage permissions or security policy.
expected_result: Only authorized IT Security role may perform those changes.
